/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.heading: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.body: BSH Taxi Services uses the information you provide through booking and contact forms only to respond to enquiries, arrange transportation, provide customer support, and improve our services. We do not sell personal information. Please contact us if you have questions about your information.

/terms.title: Terms & Conditions
/terms.heading: Terms & Conditions
/terms.body: Bookings are subject to vehicle availability, agreed fares, route conditions, tolls, permits, waiting time and the specific terms communicated at booking. Customers should confirm pickup details, travel dates and passenger requirements before the trip.
